REVIEW: BLOCKED
Reviewed-SHA: 02aa8041c250608766e74ed94042dd4cd62daaf4

Local run at this head: `npm test` 902/902 passed, `npm run check` passed, `npm run build` passed (artifact sha256 `3ff2a16b…0dba0`, which matches the PR body). The hosted `test` check is green on this head.

Findings:
1. **Merge conflict with main (blocking).** Merging into current `main` (6ab5d80) conflicts in `js/app.js`. Main landed #98, #101 and #102 after this branch's base (`7d93e87`). Fix: merge `main`, resolve `js/app.js`, and rerun the suite and artifact verify.
2. `js/account-cards.js:21-22`. The SVG always draws exactly two sub-client circles, whatever the account's real sub-client count. The deal-room-board row carries no sub-client count, so the diagram presents a structure the data does not support. Fix: render a single neutral sub-client node (or no count glyph) unless the API supplies a count, and keep the aria-label free of implied quantities.
3. `css/app.css` (the `@media(max-width:680px)` rule `.account-metrics span{font-size:8px}`) and `.flow-label` at 10px inside a 320-unit viewBox. At 390px, the metric captions ("Active work", "Attention", "Gone quiet") render at 8px, below a legible phone size. Fix: keep captions at 11px or larger and let the three-column metrics wrap or shorten.
4. Note, not blocking by itself: `test/national-accounts.test.mjs:14-21` uses the live client name and ref (Musicologie, C-161, 15/15 counts) and names two other real clients. `test/fixtures/charts-live-capture.json` on main already contains them, but this repo is public and AGENTS.md calls for synthetic fixtures. Use synthetic names in the new test.

Clean: account membership stays API-driven with nothing hardcoded; all interpolations are escaped (the injection test passes); the dark default respects an explicitly saved `light` preference; the reduced-motion override stops the pulse; the grid uses `minmax(min(100%,320px),1fr)` so it fits at 390px.
